EXPECTED-RED: none of this exists in the app — today EDIT is delete+recreate with no dialog and no gate (carb_loading_service.dart:381ff, event_action_buttons_card.dart:83-93). engine=null until the G7-G15 surfaces exist. BUNDLE: carb-loading (handback G9/G10 name these reds; emitted as their own file per the one-file-per-spec-section convention — supersedes the handback line saying "join carb-loading.json"). ORACLE CONVENTIONS the spec does not state: (1) "edited" means stored carbTargetGrams != its protocol derivation at the CURRENT weight (149.9 lb -> 67.9934 kg throughout; a stored value equal to the derivation is not an edit — pinned by repick-edit-equals-derivation-not-edited); (2) daysUntilRace is a whole-day count, race-morning = 0; (3) dialogType enum {none, keep-reset, notice}; (4) listedEdits carries F3\u2019s DATA (target day number + date + stored grams) — the rendered string is the copy register\u2019s, checked in L2, not here; (5) plans list day targets first-loading-day-first. DETECTION POWER: kept-vs-protocol gaps are 8/20/48 g (>> tolerance); dialog-type assertions are categorical (a reverted F4 fails its vector outright); the feasibility grid is enumerated, not sampled (input space is 4 equivalence classes + boundary 3). NOT COVERED (deliberate): F5 selection-time re-check (a timing behavior — L2/Patrol, not a pure-function vector); dialog/notice STRINGS (copy register + L2); the walk-only rendering states (goldens); CE-5 delete (no arithmetic — L2 asserts food-log survival); midnight rollover DURING the chooser (F5, same as above).
